{{Top|leg}}
A '''rutolu bush''' was a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with long, slender, purple leaves. A hedge of rutolu were planted in the [[Temple district/Legends#Temple Court|Temple Court]] on the southern side of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>
